evidence: Scoped finding: the 108 criteria (2 gates, 86 functional, 14 polish, 6 visual) name browser-decidable product observations, read with their injected protocols; no row-32 defect established. All task paths below are beneath .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-handoff-audit/task/. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:3 prohibits implementation/source/database inspection, :11 permits representations and routes to vary, :15 requires observed UI request shapes, and :17 requires recorded before/after facts. The constraints gate judge.toml:23-26 creates distinctive requisition/offer records and retrieves both in an independent Auditor context; a success-shaped response alone cannot satisfy it. Functional judge.toml:101,110,146,155-209 require saved exact identities, fresh readback and unchanged state after validation failures. Arithmetic probes at :218-254,335,407,470,488,497,506,515,524,533 use odd-cent, threshold, millisecond/calendar, cap and future-start cases that distinguish specific wrong formulas rather than merely asking whether numbers look right. Settlement/history criteria at :353-488,542-677 and :686-794 require actual operations, corresponding records, preserved before-values, independent-context readback or the supplied restart tool. Read-only seed and authorization criteria compare actual populated product records/relationships or credential-dependent data access, not arbitrary JSON schema. Polish judge.toml:23-77 specifies switching/reload, viewport operation and rendered accessibility/keyboard observations; :95-122 requires distinctive retained inputs, correction and successful retry; :140 holds/releases an observed real operation to expose pending state without fabricated payloads. Visual judge.toml:24-104 specifies the examined surfaces and separate five-level anchors for readable typography, contrast, spacing, hierarchy, consistency and responsive grouping. Alternative implementations are expressly accepted: a scrollable/stacked compensation view at functional judge.toml:137, names instead of exposed actor IDs at :47, native/equivalent accessible roles at polish :50/:59, native validation and a single native-date rescission input at :104/:122, and implementation-chosen layout/routes at visual prompt.md:8. A concrete broken-app challenge is corroborated by local/gate-witness/results.json: the no_op_create variant returns HTTP200 but has reqSaved=false, offerSaved=false, freshReq=false and freshOffer=false, whereas golden has all true; the written gate rejects that plausible false positive. Additional raw MCP observations show newContext plus separate UI sign-in/readback, unchanged response hold/release, and Promise.all session POSTs; local UI results record exact money preservation and one aborted rescission request followed by retained-date retry.
